digest.component_or_area: reconciler rich-text sync layer (Cloud ADF + DC wiki)
propositions: Cloud and DC rich-text send paths must encode to canonical wire form (ADF dict / wiki string) once and suppress echo on subsequent passes by comparing current Jira state vs. baseline, not by roundtrip idempotence law.

State-based suppression uses change-gated 8-byte rich_sha digest and counters persisted in binding record; at counter == 2 (exact threshold, not floor), one GET overlays observed wire into baseline via merge, never via direct write — _advance_baselines remains sole baseline writer.

Two distinct compare operations: emit-time compares decoded remote vs. normalized-then-fitted local; baseline compare normalizes local through encode-then-decode to match baseline wire, so edit-free bodies suppress across passes while Jira-native constructs (panels, mentions, dates) survive decode.

Both-sides concurrent edits remain local-wins per a713; conflicting bodies emit alert and store remote value; comment-diff dedup key on DC stays on identity codec path and must not shift when WikiTextCodec.normalize_outbound is redefined from identity to to_wire(fit(...)).

Cutover flag (new config: reconciler.rich_text_cutover, default OFF) gates both send paths; when OFF or extras absent (marklas/pandoc), behavior is plain-text wire identical to pre-cutover; with flag ON, DC CREATE and UPDATE paths both route through to_wire(fit_outbound(...)) to render Markdown to wiki before send.

Concurrent both-sides edit to same field triggers local-wins emit and outbound-field-conflict alert; binding persists change-gated rich_sha and rich_reemit counter with <0.07 KB/version overhead; one pass with no description changes modifies zero binding entries.
